mapper.select: SELECT cr.chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, b.name AS mateKey, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b.display_name), ''), b.name) AS mateName, cr.title, cr.last_message AS lastMessage, DATE_FORMAT(cr.last_message_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS lastMessageAt, cr.status FROM CHAT_ROOM cr INNER JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON e.exclusive_id = cr.exclusive_id INNER JOIN BOT b ON b.bot_id = e.bot_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND cr.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY COALESCE(cr.last_message_at, cr.created_at) DESC
